versions.content: The function Fr_GetNumOfStartupFrames shall perform the following tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx: 1. Read the number of aligned startup frame pairs received or transmitted during the previous double cycle, aggregated across both channels and write it to the output parameter Fr_NumOfStartupFramesPtr. 2. Return E_OK.
